name: Cumbria Community Foundation Laidlaw Fund for the Environment
summary: Small grants to charitable and not-for-profit organisations for wildlife habitat protection and environmental education projects in Cumbria, with priority for Carlisle and the surrounding area.

amount.note: Normally up to £2,000 over one year

applicant_types.quote: Who can apply? • charitable, not-for-profit organisations

geography.quote: Grants to organisations for projects that benefit wildlife habitat protection and education of the natural environment in Cumbria.

access.quote: All applications are now made through our online application portal

amount.quote: Grants will normally be up to £2,000 over one year.
